summary: TWO-WEEK WINDOW (2026-09-25 → 2026-10-09; the 10-02 run never published). She is talking again, and for the first time since mid-September she is asking for things herself. Week 1 looked like churn: two messages, both short replies to ALTR ('done! thanks' to Melissa's intake broadcast, then the request to take $200 off the Sept 15-30 invoice for OFTV editing). Week 2 turned around. Mayson came back on 10-05 after 16 days away and asked for a check-up call. She answered in 7 minutes and joined the call that day; she mentioned she is in Italy, which probably explains part of the late-September quiet. On 10-07 Mayson moved her link-in-bio to a Telegram channel as a safety step. She replied within 2 minutes with three asks: rename the channel ('Don’t think Sarah’s dungeon matches my vibe'), a placement question, and then a screenshot showing the link was not displaying correctly. Mayson said 'I’ll get back to you'. His next message, 90 minutes later, was a content-upload chase, not an answer. On 10-09 she chased: 'Any update on the telegram or link? My highlights have been banned'. That was still unanswered when the window closed, and it is a new Instagram restriction with no Meta-support owner tagged. MONEY: Stephski reissued the Sept 15-30 invoice with the $200 OFTV credit about 23h after the request. Sarah paid it 4 minutes later ('Paid! Thanks'), 6 days early. Nobody has confirmed receipt, and Sept 1-14 is still unconfirmed 17 days past due. Under ALTR's churn pattern, fast clean payment is a tell. It is offset here by the asks going back up to 5. CHURN SIGNALS: owner silence is present (Derrek and Noah last posted 2026-08-25, 45 days). Long-promised deliverables with no written proof are present (Phone Farm updates, the whale plan, the Aug 25 call write-up, CB tracking link, Snapchat role access). The 10-05 call also has no written recap, which repeats the 08-25 pattern of a call replacing a written answer. Billing-dominated ALTR traffic: not present (6 of 21 team messages). WINS: the DMCA weekly report landed on time twice (09-25, 10-02), and the domain came out of her bio for safety. No credentials were posted this window, but nothing exposed earlier has been rotated. Export ids 1002-1003 (10-02, between the DMCA post and the corrected invoice) are missing.

She took a call the same day (10-05), replied within 2 minutes to the Telegram link change, and chased an unanswered item herself on 10-09. A client heading out does not usually do that; one who still expects us to fix things does. Italy travel also gives a benign reason for the late-September silence. (4) Her first new issue in weeks (Telegram link not displaying, then highlights banned) got 'I’ll get back to you' followed by a content chase. It was unanswered at close. (5) Sept 1-14 receipt is still unconfirmed 17 days past due, and the OFTV credit was omitted for the second time. (6) Credentials from 07-29 and 09-11 are still not rotated. The rise depends on one person: Mayson is the only ALTR voice she is engaging with. If the link and highlights issue is not closed fast, the recovery reverses.
